title: Juicy Syrian Steak Kebabs
description: A Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring sirloin steak tips marinated in a fermented mixture, resulting in a velvety texture and a crowd-pleasing flavor, with an al-dente finish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the sirloin steak tips to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the steak mixture for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the meat to ferment and absorb the flavors.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, threading the marinated steak tips onto skewers if using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes beforehand.
Grill the steak kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
Let the steak kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving, garnished with chopped parsley.
Serve the steak kebabs hot, accompanied by your choice of sides such as roasted vegetables, quinoa, or pita bread.
Leftover steak kebabs can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, reheating them in the microwave or oven when needed.
